\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt
    \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{#2}%
  \fi
  \raisebox{0pt}[\dlboxheight][\dlboxdepth]{%
    \makebox[\dlboxwidth][l]{\resizebox{\dlboxwidth}{!}{\strut #2}}%
  }%

}

\section*{Multiple Choice (30 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{A person who is not very well organized, rarely sets goals, and frequently puts things off until the last minute would be said to be low on which trait?}{A person who is cooperative, trusting, and helpful would be said to be high on which trait?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Agreeableness
    \item Conscientiousness
    \item Openness
    \item Neuroticism
\end{enumerate}
\item Current estimates of how many people exercise on a regular basis suggest that \_\_\_\_\_ do
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Less than 50\%
    \item More than 75\%
    \item Less than 25\%
    \item More than 50\%
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following drugs inhibit herpes viruses?}{Which of the following drugs is used to treat influenza A virus infections?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Amantadine
    \item Acyclovir
    \item Oseltamivir
    \item Azidothymidine
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Older married men have been found to have}{Older divorced men have been found to have}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Higher levels of positive emotions
    \item Lower levels of positive emotions
    \item Higher levels of negative emotions
    \item Lower levels of negative emotions
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The spheno-occipital synchondrosis}{The mandibular condylar cartilage}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item is a secondary growth cartilage.
    \item influences the position of the viscerocranium.
    \item ceases activity at 7 years of age.
    \item can be reactivated in patients affected by acromegaly.
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following changes is NOT associated with menopause?}{Which of the following changes is typically associated with menopause?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item the walls of the vagina become thick
    \item the vagina shrinks in length
    \item the labia minora shrink
    \item production of estrogen declines
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Laryngeal oedema is usually confined to the larynx above the vocal folds because}{Mucus tends to accumulate in the vestibular folds because}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item there are numerous mucous glands in the vestibular folds.
    \item the mucosa covering the vocal folds is tightly attached to underlying tissues.
    \item fluid will drain rapidly into the thorax below the vocal folds.
    \item the mucosa above the vocal folds is more vascular than that below the vocal folds.
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Vasocongestion is a process of :}{Orgasm is primarily a process of :}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item muscle contraction
    \item blood accumulation in the genitals
    \item muscle relaxation
    \item detumescence
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{What is urban yellow fever (YF)?}{What is sylvatic yellow fever (YF)?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Part of a cycle of mosquitoes biting humans in cities
    \item Part of a cycle of mosquitoes biting humans and monkeys in forested areas
    \item A mutant of the YF virus
    \item A YF species that has adapted to new mosquitoes
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following is one of McAdam's levels of personality?}{Which of the following is a key virtue in Erikson's theory of adult development?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Control
    \item Identity
    \item Generativity
    \item Assimilation
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following is the most important variable for gerontological researchers?}{Which of the following is typically considered the most basic demographic variable?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Age
    \item Gender
    \item Cohort
    \item Time of measurement
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Cells in the eye that respond to low levels of illumination are called}{Cells in the eye that respond to bright color vision are called}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Rods
    \item Cones
    \item Retinal cells
    \item Nocturnal detectors
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Comorbidity is a problem for older adults because it}{A highly lethal infectious disease is a problem for older adults because it}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Makes correct diagnoses difficult
    \item Increases funeral costs
    \item Is very contagious
    \item Cannot, at present, be cured
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{If you run your finger down the anterior midline of a patient's extended neck from chin to sternal notch, you should be able to palpate, in order, the}{If you run your finger up the anterior midline of the neck from sternal notch to chin, you should be able to palpate, in order, the}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item hyoid bone, cricoid cartilage, thyroid cartilage.
    \item thyroid cartilage, cricoid cartilage, hyoid bone.
    \item hyoid bone, thyroid cartilage, cricoid cartilage.
    \item thyroid cartilage, hyoid bone, cricoids cartilage.
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Complete the following sentence. The Philadelphia chromosome:}{Complete the following sentence. Double minutes in cancer cells:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item is an example of gene amplification.
    \item is a product of a reciprocal translocation.
    \item causes Burkitt's lymphoma.
    \item causes retinoblastoma.
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
